answer: Survey agents may wander from quartz pits to willow plantations, but pay them for unique coverage rather than registrations. Publish an immutable grid and one reward per cell per survey window. Each claim needs a signed land-access permit and independently checked, dated measurements; a shared registry rejects cells already paid. Parcel renaming and title subdivision do not alter grid coordinates. Extra aliases cannot resell the same survey. Earning more requires securing access to more cells and paying for fresh fieldwork. This assumes reliable measurement checks.
